description: Agent Migration: submit the export taken from the source system for one move, with the plan it serves: how the export is presented (full, partial or a sample), its format (JSON, JSON lines, CSV, a SQL dump, Parquet, XML, an archive, PDF, HTML, a proprietary format, binary or other), the tools or target systems known to read it and when it was taken; and each item the plan lists as moving, or the export holds, with whether it is planned, whether the export contains it, the record count the source’s own record holds, the count the export holds and its format when it differs. The signed report lists every item as complete, missing, extra, short or unreadable, totals the planned items and the source and export records, and names an export that is incomplete: a partial export presented as full, record counts that do not match the source’s own record, and an export in a format nothing named can read; then planned items missing from an export presented as partial, exported items the plan does not list and records exported only as pages a person reads, with the fix for each. Whether a reputation record can be exported from its platform in principle is wever_reputation-portability-check, and the data export section of a handover package is wever_handover-check. Verdict source_export_incomplete, source_export_gaps, source_export_unverified or source_export_complete. POST /api/migration-export-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write, and no data is moved. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-migration-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-migration/.

items.description: Each item the plan lists as moving, with what the export holds.

export_count.description: How many records the export holds for it.

format.description: Its format when it differs from the export’s.

name.description: An item the plan lists as moving, or one the export holds.

planned.description: The plan lists it as moving; true when left out.

source_count.description: How many records the source’s own record holds for it.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

format.description: JSON, JSON lines, CSV, a SQL dump, Parquet, XML, an archive, PDF, HTML, a proprietary format, binary or other.

presented_as.description: How the export is described to the people relying on it: full, partial or a sample.

readable_by.description: The tools or target systems known to read the format.

name: wever_migration-export-check
title: Migration export check
